sections.text_helper: Section 78.11.9 "Breakpoint Unit (BPU)" in chapter 78 (Debug support (DBG)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 4460.
sections.section_content:
The BPU allows hardware breakpoints to be set. It contains eight comparators which
monitor the instruction fetch address. If a match occurs, the instruction comparators can be
configured to generate a breakpoint instruction.
